bitfield.description: Selects the defferent modes for ULL RAM: #br# 00: Functional Mode. #br# 01: Writes are allowed to data bits only. No write to ECC bits. #br# 10: Writes are allowed to ECC bits only. No write to data bits. #br# 11: Same as functional mode

Selects the defferent modes for GLXMP_0 RAM: #br# 00: Functional Mode. #br# 01: Writes are allowed to data bits only. No write to ECC bits. #br# 10: Writes are allowed to ECC bits only. No write to data bits. #br# 11: Same as functional mode

Selects the defferent modes for GLXMP_1 RAM: #br# 00: Functional Mode. #br# 01: Writes are allowed to data bits only. No write to ECC bits. #br# 10: Writes are allowed to ECC bits only. No write to data bits. #br# 11: Same as functional mode

Selects the defferent modes for GLXMP_2 RAM: #br# 00: Functional Mode. #br# 01: Writes are allowed to data bits only. No write to ECC bits. #br# 10: Writes are allowed to ECC bits only. No write to data bits. #br# 11: Same as functional mode
Cache configuration for ULL RAM: #br# 1: Cache enable. #br# 0: Cache support disable.
Cache configuration for GLXMP_0 RAM: #br# 1: Cache enable. #br# 0: Cache support disable.
Cache configuration for GLXMP_1 RAM: #br# 1: Cache enable. #br# 0: Cache support disable.
Cache configuration for GLXMP_2 RAM: #br# 1: Cache enable. #br# 0: Cache support disable.
Wait state configuration for ULL RAM: #br# 0: 1wait state disable. #br# 1: 1 wait enable.
Wait state configuration for GLXMP_0 RAM: #br# 0: 1wait state disable. #br# 1: 1 wait enable.
Wait state configuration for GLXMP_1 RAM: #br# 0: 1wait state disable. #br# 1: 1 wait enable.
Wait state configuration for GLXMP_2 RAM: #br# 0: 1wait state disable. #br# 1: 1 wait enable.
Cache clear configuration for ULL RAM: #br# 0: wont clear the cache valid slots. #br# 1: Clear the all cache valid slots and write back the write buffer data to memory macro.
Cache clear configuration for GLAMP_0 RAM: #br# 0: wont clear the cache valid slots. #br# 1: Clear the all cache valid slots and write back the write buffer data to memory macro.
Cache clear configuration for GLXMP_1 RAM: #br# 0: wont clear the cache valid slots. #br# 1: Clear the all cache valid slots and write back the write buffer data to memory macro.
Cache clear configuration for GLXMP_2 RAM: #br# 0: wont clear the cache valid slots. #br# 1: Clear the all cache valid slots and write back the write buffer data to memory macro.
